# Kick-off meeting: Acme Logistics delivery app

**Date:** October 1, 2026
**Attendees:** Sarah Khan (Acme), Tom Becker (Acme), Rahim Uddin, Priya Nair

---

## Goals

Acme wants a mobile app for drivers and a web dashboard for dispatchers.
The first release should be ready before the holiday season.

## Decisions

- Drivers log in with their phone number and a one-time code.
- Dispatchers can reassign a delivery to another driver at any time.

## Open questions

Sarah asked whether the app must work offline in areas with bad signal. Tom will check with the drivers.

The system should be easy to use.
